measurement: MP-R0B connected-only refusal (no runtime endpoint available)
note: Only the refusal is captured here: the connected CPU and working-set baseline was not measured because no reachable runtime endpoint exists in this environment. The refusal demonstrates that a connected run cannot be recorded against an unreachable endpoint.
foreground_attempt: A loopback listener satisfied reachability and the connected probe was run, but the application refused startup with exit code 2 and the message 'COS Desktop instance ownership unavailable; startup refused', so no window existed and Add-Type, SetForegroundWindow, GetForegroundWindow and the UI Automation read were never reached. The cause of the exit is now identified from the application's own stderr, not assumed; the foreground path stays unproven.
add_type_scope: Add-Type sits before the application launch, so the script reached and executed that declaration; what is missing is an independent record that the type generation succeeded, and the calls that use the type were never reached.
